title: Coppiously
summary: COPPIOUSLY, adverb 1. Abundantly; plentifully; in large quantities. 2. Largely; fully; amply; diffusely. The remains of antiquity have been copiously described by travelers.

inlines.v: COPPIOUSLY, adverb 1. Abundantly; plentifully; in large quantities. 2. Largely; fully; amply; diffusely. The remains of antiquity have been copiously described by travelers.
